text:
**Three of the 25 obligor groups with an approved limit are over it at 2026-09-30, once every controlled subsidiary is counted: Brightwater, Halvorsen and Corvane.** All three are still under the $360M legal lending limit. In each group the parent company carries little of the exposure itself; the breach only shows up when the subsidiaries are added.

| Obligor group (ultimate parent) | Loan commitments (active) | Derivatives current exposure | **Group exposure** | Approved limit | Over by | Utilization |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Brightwater Group Inc** (LE-10030) | $236.6M (21 facilities, 13 borrowers) | $0 | **$236.6M** | $200M | **+$36.6M** | **118.3%** |
| **Halvorsen Industrial Group Inc** (LE-10001) | $308.0M (10 facilities) | $36.3M | **$344.3M** | $300M | **+$44.3M** | **114.8%** |
| **Corvane Partners Inc** (LE-10052) | $171.2M (16 facilities, 11 borrowers) | $0 (3 swaps, all with negative market value) | **$171.2M** | $150M | **+$21.2M** | **114.1%** |

**Why it only shows up at group level**
- **Brightwater:** the parent has just $1.6M (one revolving line). Twelve subsidiaries carry the other $235.0M, nine of them with $20–26M each.
- **Corvane:** the parent has only $2.2M. Ten subsidiaries hold $169.0M.
- **Halvorsen:** this matches the earlier answer about the downgrade. The parent has $40M directly. The Kestrel companies, bought in 2025, add $134.5M, and the deprecated legacy hierarchy table would miss them.

**Credit points**
- **Guarantees:** all of Brightwater's and Corvane's active guarantees (5 and 3) come from companies inside their own groups, so they don't reduce exposure (rule BR-GUAR-01). Halvorsen has one outside guarantee: a $30M surety from Northcastle Mutual on facility F0000008. Even if you count it, Halvorsen is still about $14.3M over. Its $20M Brandvold guarantee expired on 2026-06-30.
- **Ratings (lower of the parent's two agency ratings, rule BR-RATE-01):**
  - Halvorsen is CCC+, internal rating 8 (Substandard), after AGY1 downgraded it on 2026-09-28.
  - Brightwater and Corvane are both B+, internal rating 6 (Pass), with AGY1 on negative outlook.
- **Approval:** any credit action on these three groups goes to the Senior Credit Committee, because they are over their group limit (rule BR-DLA-01).
- **Close to the limit (watch list):** Stellmark at 91.5% ($164.7M of $180M) and Ridgeport at 90.1% ($108.1M of $120M). All other groups are at 83% or below.

**Sources and definitions**
- **Exposure definition (rule BR-EXP-01):** committed amount of active facilities (`BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY`) plus derivatives current exposure at the latest snapshot, 2026-09-30 (`RISK_DEMO.dbo.CM_EXPOSURE`). Notional amounts and drawn balances are not counted.
- **Limits and utilization:** limits from `dbo.CREDIT_LIMIT` (one group limit per parent). Utilization is exposure divided by the limit, using the knowledge layer's agreed definition.
- **Group membership (rule BR-CUST-01):** from the knowledge layer's governed `obligor_groups` reference data. It includes only companies the parent currently controls, at any depth, built from `dbo.OWNERSHIP`; minority joint ventures and sold companies are left out. It also gives the borrower numbers (CIF) used on each platform.
- **Guarantees and ratings:** from `dbo.GUARANTEE`, `dbo.RATING` and `dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY`. The legal lending limit is $360M (rule BR-LLL-01).
- **Assumptions:** the knowledge layer's ownership-tracing tool (`trace_obligor_group`) failed with an error, so I used the governed group list without re-tracing each hierarchy. Utilization is shown gross, as the agreed definition specifies; only the Halvorsen surety would change a net figure. I did not use the deprecated tables (`CPTY_HIER_LEGACY`, `CM_EXPOSURE_ARCHIVE`).

cypher.cypher:
MATCH (d:DecisionTrace {id: $id}) UNWIND $names AS nm
                  CALL (nm) {
                    MATCH (n) WHERE (n:Concept OR n:DataProduct OR n:Metric OR n:JoinPath OR n:Policy OR n:Report OR n:BusinessRule)
                      AND (toLower(n.name) = toLower(nm) OR n.id = nm OR toLower(n.id) = toLower(nm))
                    RETURN n LIMIT 1
                    UNION
                    MATCH (n:Table) WHERE toUpper(n.fq_name) = toUpper(nm) OR toUpper(n.fq_name) ENDS WITH '.' + toUpper(nm)
                    RETURN n LIMIT 1 }
                  MERGE (d)-[:USED]->(n) RETURN collect(DISTINCT coalesce(n.fq_name, n.name, n.id)) AS linked

MATCH (d:DecisionTrace {id: $id}) UNWIND $ids AS eid
                 MATCH (n:LegalEntity) WHERE n.id = eid
                 MERGE (d)-[:ABOUT]->(n) RETURN collect(DISTINCT n.id) AS about

MATCH (d:DecisionTrace {id: $id}) UNWIND $checks AS c
                   MATCH (p:Policy {id: c.policy})
                   MERGE (d)-[r:CHECKED]->(p) SET r.decision = c.decision RETURN collect(p.id + ':' + c.decision) AS checked
